answered.sql: SELECT QA_Testers.fullName, Test_Cases.caseType, Test_Cases.description FROM Quality_Assurance_Testers AS QA_Testers JOIN Qualified_Tests ON QA_Testers.testerID = Qualified_Tests.testerID JOIN Test_Cases ON Qualified_Tests.testCaseID = Test_Cases.testCaseID

candidates.meaning: List the different types of test cases along with their descriptions, and associate them with the testers who use them.
candidates.sql: SELECT T2.caseType, T2.description, T1.fullName FROM Quality_Assurance_Testers AS T1 JOIN Qualified_Tests AS T3 ON T1.testerID = T3.testerID JOIN Test_Cases AS T2 ON T3.testCaseID = T2.testCaseID

candidates.meaning: List the types of test cases and their descriptions, grouped by the tester who uses them.
candidates.sql: SELECT tc.caseType, tc.description, qt.testerID, qa.fullName FROM Qualified_Tests qt JOIN Test_Cases tc ON qt.testCaseID = tc.testCaseID JOIN Quality_Assurance_Testers qa ON qt.testerID = qa.testerID

candidates.meaning: Provide a summary of the test cases and their descriptions, indicating which tester uses each type.
candidates.sql: SELECT tc.caseType, tc.description, GROUP_CONCAT(qt.testerID) AS testerIDs, GROUP_CONCAT(qa.fullName) AS testerNames FROM Qualified_Tests qt JOIN Test_Cases tc ON qt.testCaseID = tc.testCaseID JOIN Quality_Assurance_Testers qa ON qt.testerID = qa.testerID GROUP BY tc.caseType, tc.description

candidates.meaning: Display the unique combination of test cases and their descriptions used by each tester.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT qa.testerID, tc.caseType, tc.description FROM Qualified_Tests qt JOIN Test_Cases tc ON qt.testCaseID = tc.testCaseID JOIN Quality_Assurance_Testers qa ON qt.testerID = qa.testerID

candidates.meaning: List the types of test cases used by each tester along with their descriptions.
candidates.sql: SELECT qa_testers.fullName, test_cases.caseType, test_cases.description FROM Quality_Assurance_Testers AS qa_testers JOIN Qualified_Tests ON qa_testers.testerID = Qualified_Tests.testerID JOIN Test_Cases ON Qualified_Tests.testCaseID = Test_Cases.testCaseID

candidates.meaning: Provide a summary of the test cases used by each tester, grouped by tester and case type, showing the description of each case type.
candidates.sql: SELECT qa_testers.fullName, test_cases.caseType, GROUP_CONCAT(test_cases.description) AS descriptions FROM Quality_Assurance_Testers AS qa_testers JOIN Qualified_Tests ON qa_testers.testerID = Qualified_Tests.testerID JOIN Test_Cases ON Qualified_Tests.testCaseID = Test_Cases.testCaseID GROUP BY qa_testers.fullName, test_cases.caseType

candidates.meaning: Identify the unique test cases used by each tester and list them with their descriptions.
candidates.sql: SELECT qa_testers.fullName, DISTINCT test_cases.caseType, test_cases.description FROM Quality_Assurance_Testers AS qa_testers JOIN Qualified_Tests ON qa_testers.testerID = Qualified_Tests.testerID JOIN Test_Cases ON Qualified_Tests.testCaseID = Test_Cases.testCaseID
